messages:
Ana: Quick sync — planning a stacked tutorials launch for next Wed. Need: 2 written tutorials (basic + advanced), a reference app demo, a short benchmark post, and 2 3-min screencasts. Who can take which piece?
Kevin: I can take the reference app + PR for repo. ETA Tue EOD for initial skeleton.
Marta: I'll draft the benchmark narrative and run perf runs on gpt-like open models. Will need sample prompts — @Ana can you share target workloads?
Ana: Sending prompt doc: https://notion.so/stacked-tutorials-prompt-doc and tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/stacked-tutorials-tracker
Sam: I can handle the two short videos and host the demo on the dev site. Also can confirm infra for the demo — we should use Dedicated staging.
Kevin: For the repo we'll include a quickstart and an automated ci check. Proposed README layout:
```
- Overview
- Quickstart (curl + SDK)
- Benchmarks (scripts)
- Contributing
```
Marta: For benchmarks, let's capture both latency and cost per 1k tokens, plus cache impact. I'll add a small script that hits the API with batching flags.
Sam: Hosting note — use UTM params for inbound leads: ?utm_source=stacked-tutorials&utm_medium=refapp
Ana: Can we get a hero screenshot and one architecture diagram? @Kevin can you add diagram to the repo as SVG?
Kevin: Yep, I’ll add SVG and a minimal CI job to build it.
devrel-bot: Calendar invite created: "Stacked Tutorials Launch checklist review" scheduled for 1812410000 — attendees: Ana, Kevin, Marta, Sam.
Ana: Great. Owners: Kevin=repo+readme, Marta=benchmarks+post, Sam=videos+hosting, Ana=blog post+launch copy. Target publish: next Wed 09:00 PT.
Marta: Quick question — do we want to mention quantization recommendations in the bench post? I think yes — short section with pros/cons.
Ana: Yes, call out quant profiles and a small table. Keep it developer-first and prescriptive.
Kevin: I'll open PRs for the repo + README today. Please add review comments on the PR tag.
Sam: I'll capture the screencast raw footage Mon, edit Tue.
Ana: Also thinking about a short webinar/AMA the week after — low-commit, 30min; repurpose video clips. Thoughts?
Marta: Good idea — we can highlight benchmark results and field implementation QA.
Kevin: Let's add a slide with quickstart + code snippet for the demo.
Ana: Thanks all — ping here for blockers. :rocket:
